set.body: Goal: small-multiples on top of the layout solver: a facet spec partitions rows into panels; the solver allocates a grid of named panel regions plus shared axes and facet strips; scales shared or free per ggplot semantics. Acceptance: PlotFrames generalizes to a panel grid with stable names (panel-r-c, strip-*); shared-scale training unions across facets; conformance gains a faceted case; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: facets and panel grids
